record.paper_title: Open problems posed at the tenth International conference on fuzzy set theory and applications (FSTA 2010, Liptovsky Jan, Slovakia)
record.original_question: For a power-stable binary operation O:[0,1]^2 -> [0,1], where O(x^p,y^p)=O(x,y)^p for every p>0, determine how structural and regularity properties of O correspond to properties of the one-variable functions f and g that represent O in the standard power-stable forms O(x,y)=(xy)^{f(log(x)/log(xy))} and O(x,y)=(xy)^{g(log(x)/log(y))}. The properties to relate include monotonicity, continuity, the 1-Lipschitz property, associativity, and existence of a neutral element.

artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return authoritative follow-up work that fully characterizes the properties (monotonicity, continuity, 1-Lipschitz, associativity, neutral element) of power-stable binary operations on [0,1] in terms of the generating functions f and g. The status of the problem could not be conclusively verified.
